policy: Keep only these two small self-owned historical jars locally; do not add them to Git. Do not retain or recreate whole Minecraft instances. No deletion is authorized.

localOnlyAcceptedInputs.purpose: Exact historical accepted mixed-working-tree product; cannot be reconstructed byte-for-byte from a single commit.
Exact QA binary for the historical acceptance; jar timestamp/order means the preserved source need not reproduce identical bytes.

remainingNonPreservedMaterial: Raw screenshots/logs/instance worlds and copied pack resources are intentionally not part of the source handoff. Historical evidence summary and resource metrics are already versioned.
